result.rationale: When credential sync is enabled, refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response (from the CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT call). The Google caller does `const token = res?.data;` followed by `token.access_token` — a fetch Response has no `.data` property, so this throws inside the try block (whose catch presumably swallows the failure) and the caller proceeds with the expired credentials.
